title: Lint Providers Schema
description: Schema for lint provider definitions that define how linting tools operate

lint-providers.description: Map of lint provider name to configuration

lint_provider.description: A lint provider definition that describes how to run a linting tool

description.description: Human-readable description of the lint provider

input_mode.description: How files are passed to the linter

config_files.description: Standard config file names for auto-discovery (e.g., [".golangci.yml"])

applies_to.description: Component types this linter can process (e.g., ["go"], ["typescript", "javascript"])

options.description: Optional behavior flags for the lint provider

allow_parallel.description: Whether multiple instances can run simultaneously

auto_fix.description: Whether the linter supports --fix or equivalent
